k: It spins its webs between floating islands. Nobody knows what it catches up there. Nobody wants to.
src: 'It spins its webs between floating islands. Nobody knows what it catches up there. Nobody wants to.'

k: Skybrine Eel
src: 'Skybrine Eel'

k: A sea eel, swimming through the air as if it never noticed the water leave. Perhaps it hasn't.
src: 'A sea eel, swimming through the air as if it never noticed the water leave. Perhaps it hasn\'t.'

k: Sun-Ember Wisp
src: 'Sun-Ember Wisp'

k: A fleck of the broken sun, still burning a year later. It is warm. Nothing else in the world is warm anymore.
src: 'A fleck of the broken sun, still burning a year later. It is warm. Nothing else in the world is warm anymore.'

k: Abyss Eye
src: 'Abyss Eye'

k: The abyss under the islands is not empty. Sometimes it looks up.
src: 'The abyss under the islands is not empty. Sometimes it looks up.'

k: Wreck Mimic
src: 'Wreck Mimic'

k: A sea-chest from some drowned rich man's cabin. It has learned that people will walk straight up to a sea-chest.
src: 'A sea-chest from some drowned rich man\'s cabin. It has learned that people will walk straight up to a sea-chest.'

k: Old Fennick
src: 'Old Fennick'

k: Edrin Halloway's fishing partner. The light said Vanguard. He said "fish." The light didn't argue.
src: 'Edrin Halloway\'s fishing partner. The light said Vanguard. He said "fish." The light didn\'t argue.'

k: The Ashmaw
src: 'The Ashmaw'

k: A hound of packed ash the size of a cart. It has been eating Fennick's chickens all winter.
src: 'A hound of packed ash the size of a cart. It has been eating Fennick\'s chickens all winter.'

k: The biggest thing the glass ever made. It is so clear you can see the sky through it — bent, and broken, and beautiful.
src: 'The biggest thing the glass ever made. It is so clear you can see the sky through it — bent, and broken, and beautiful.'

k: The Lidless
src: 'The Lidless'

k: It has no lid. It has never blinked. It has seen everything that has fallen past its perch for a year.
src: 'It has no lid. It has never blinked. It has seen everything that has fallen past its perch for a year.'

k: Brinefang, Unmoored
src: 'Brinefang, Unmoored'

k: The serpent of the strait, still swimming the sea that isn't there. The Gloam got into it on the way up. It has a scar on its jaw shaped like a Dawnguard shield.
src: 'The serpent of the strait, still swimming the sea that isn\'t there. The Gloam got into it on the way up. It has a scar on its jaw shaped like a Dawnguard shield.'

k: Brine Wisp
src: 'Brine Wisp'

k: A skin of old brine, shed by the Unmoored. It swims on without it.
src: 'A skin of old brine, shed by the Unmoored. It swims on without it.'

k: "Here it comes — GUARD, girl!"
src: '"Here it comes — GUARD, girl!"'

k: "Let's see what's left in that arm."
src: '"Let\'s see what\'s left in that arm."'

k: Fennick plants his feet and draws his harpoon back. "Watch my shoulders. When they drop like this — that's your cue."
src: 'Fennick plants his feet and draws his harpoon back. "Watch my shoulders. When they drop like this — that\'s your cue."'

k: "Hff. I used to be faster. Your father was faster still."
src: '"Hff. I used to be faster. Your father was faster still."'

k: The Ashmaw pounces!
src: 'The Ashmaw pounces!'

k: The Ashmaw howls. The ash on the bridge pulls itself up into a smaller hound.
src: 'The Ashmaw howls. The ash on the bridge pulls itself up into a smaller hound.'

k: The Ashmaw crouches low, ash streaming off its back like smoke...
src: 'The Ashmaw crouches low, ash streaming off its back like smoke...'

k: Glassback brings its whole weight down on the quarry floor!
src: 'Glassback brings its whole weight down on the quarry floor!'

k: Its glass hide clouds over and thickens.
src: 'Its glass hide clouds over and thickens.'

k: Glassback rears up. Light splinters through its body...
src: 'Glassback rears up. Light splinters through its body...'

k: The Lidless looks at you. All of it looks at you.
src: 'The Lidless looks at you. All of it looks at you.'

k: It blinks — it has no lid, and it blinks — and now there are more eyes.
src: 'It blinks — it has no lid, and it blinks — and now there are more eyes.'

k: The Lidless opens wider... and wider...
src: 'The Lidless opens wider... and wider...'

k: Brinefang brings the hanging sea crashing down!
src: 'Brinefang brings the hanging sea crashing down!'

k: Brinefang sheds a skin of brine — and the skin gets up and swims.
src: 'Brinefang sheds a skin of brine — and the skin gets up and swims.'

k: Brinefang climbs into the broken sky — higher — higher — and turns, and falls toward you...
src: 'Brinefang climbs into the broken sky — higher — higher — and turns, and falls toward you...'

k: Brinefang draws the upside-down sea into its throat...
src: 'Brinefang draws the upside-down sea into its throat...'

k: Gus's Salvage & Sundries
src: 'Gus\'s Salvage & Sundries'

k: A broken piece of Lanternfall's north cliffs. An old man, a burnt soup, two cairns.
src: 'A broken piece of Lanternfall\'s north cliffs. An old man, a burnt soup, two cairns.'

k: A refugee town built from upturned boats. Six hundred people, one soup kettle.
src: 'A refugee town built from upturned boats. Six hundred people, one soup kettle.'

k: The old strait between Lanternfall and the mainland. No water in it now — only wreckage and the long drop.
src: 'The old strait between Lanternfall and the mainland. No water in it now — only wreckage and the long drop.'

k: Ward Water
src: 'Ward Water'

k: A bucket from the rationed well, for the Ember Ward.
src: 'A bucket from the rationed well, for the Ember Ward.'

k: Sunsalt Phials
src: 'Sunsalt Phials'

k: The Choir's remedy for Gloam-rot. Each phial glows like a coal kept under ash.
src: 'The Choir\'s remedy for Gloam-rot. Each phial glows like a coal kept under ash.'

k: Three Tin Tags
src: 'Three Tin Tags'

k: DORAN. MAGS. LITTLE COBB. The third sunsalt team.
src: 'DORAN. MAGS. LITTLE COBB. The third sunsalt team.'

k: Captain Buttons
src: 'Captain Buttons'

k: A rag doll with one button eye. Very brave.
src: 'A rag doll with one button eye. Very brave.'

k: Dawnmoss Seeds
src: 'Dawnmoss Seeds'

k: Gold-green spores in a Choir apothecary tin. They will grow in anything.
src: 'Gold-green spores in a Choir apothecary tin. They will grow in anything.'

k: Bell Clapper
src: 'Bell Clapper'

k: The clapper of the Bellwrights' Tenor. Heavy as a promise, dented from the fall.
src: 'The clapper of the Bellwrights\' Tenor. Heavy as a promise, dented from the fall.'

k: Dead Letters
src: 'Dead Letters'

k: Three letters from Petra's bag, posted the day before the world ended.
src: 'Three letters from Petra\'s bag, posted the day before the world ended.'

k: A Letter for Wren
src: 'A Letter for Wren'

k: "My dear restless heart — I have kept a place for you." Choir seal, broken.
src: '"My dear restless heart — I have kept a place for you." Choir seal, broken.'

k: Rotgnawer
src: 'Rotgnawer'

k: Undercroft rats that ate what the rot left behind, and caught it. Their bite carries it on.
src: 'Undercroft rats that ate what the rot left behind, and caught it. Their bite carries it on.'

k: Rot Bloom
src: 'Rot Bloom'

k: Gloam-rot, given time and darkness and nothing else to do, learns to flower.
src: 'Gloam-rot, given time and darkness and nothing else to do, learns to flower.'

k: Drowned Acolyte
src: 'Drowned Acolyte'

k: An acolyte of the Under-Choir. It drowned singing. It is still singing.
src: 'An acolyte of the Under-Choir. It drowned singing. It is still singing.'

k: Knell Wisp
src: 'Knell Wisp'

k: The last note of a bell that broke mid-toll. It drifts, still ringing, looking for the rest of itself.
src: 'The last note of a bell that broke mid-toll. It drifts, still ringing, looking for the rest of itself.'

k: Ossuary Warden
src: 'Ossuary Warden'

k: Aurenne's honored dead were buried with their swords. Some of them never put the swords down.
src: 'Aurenne\'s honored dead were buried with their swords. Some of them never put the swords down.'

k: The Unfinished
src: 'The Unfinished'

k: One of Sister Mercy's Remembrances, never finished. It is trying very hard to remember a face. Any face.
src: 'One of Sister Mercy\'s Remembrances, never finished. It is trying very hard to remember a face. Any face.'

k: Cistern Eel
src: 'Cistern Eel'

k: They came up the drains when the sea fell into the sky. They are not going back.
src: 'They came up the drains when the sea fell into the sky. They are not going back.'

k: Bellshell Crab
src: 'Bellshell Crab'

k: It wears a handbell for a shell. When it is angry, which is always, it rings.
src: 'It wears a handbell for a shell. When it is angry, which is always, it rings.'

k: Drowned Cantor
src: 'Drowned Cantor'

k: A cantor of the Under-Choir. Its voice holds the others together, the way a nail holds a coffin.
src: 'A cantor of the Under-Choir. Its voice holds the others together, the way a nail holds a coffin.'

k: Drowned Chorister
src: 'Drowned Chorister'

k: One voice in the Drowned Choir. Alone, it is only a drowned child. Together, they are a hymn.
src: 'One voice in the Drowned Choir. Alone, it is only a drowned child. Together, they are a hymn.'

k: The Under-Choir's Precentor. He was told to hold the note until noon. He is a very obedient man.
src: 'The Under-Choir\'s Precentor. He was told to hold the note until noon. He is a very obedient man.'

k: Old Clapper
src: 'Old Clapper'

k: A rust-red wyrm that nested in the Reliquary and swallowed a bell whole. It tolls when it breathes.
src: 'A rust-red wyrm that nested in the Reliquary and swallowed a bell whole. It tolls when it breathes.'

k: The Held Note breaks over you — the Dawnsong, sung backward!
src: 'The Held Note breaks over you — the Dawnsong, sung backward!'

k: The harmony falters. The Precentor's note cracks into a wail.
src: 'The harmony falters. The Precentor\'s note cracks into a wail.'

k: "Louder. LOUDER. Let the water carry it!" The cistern surges.
src: '"Louder. LOUDER. Let the water carry it!" The cistern surges.'

k: "Hold it... hold it until noon..."
src: '"Hold it... hold it until noon..."'

k: The Precentor lifts his baton. A drowned voice answers from the water.
src: 'The Precentor lifts his baton. A drowned voice answers from the water.'

k: The choristers hold one swelling note. Silence one of them — quickly!
src: 'The choristers hold one swelling note. Silence one of them — quickly!'

k: _BONNNG._ The sound comes out as fire.
src: '_BONNNG._ The sound comes out as fire.'

k: Old Clapper thrashes. Rust and bell-metal rain from the ceiling!
src: 'Old Clapper thrashes. Rust and bell-metal rain from the ceiling!'

k: Deep in Old Clapper's belly, something begins to toll. Brace yourselves!
src: 'Deep in Old Clapper\'s belly, something begins to toll. Brace yourselves!'

k: The City of Bells, silent and drifting. Ilse's Ember Ward keeps its people breathing.
src: 'The City of Bells, silent and drifting. Ilse\'s Ember Ward keeps its people breathing.'

k: Brig Key
src: 'Brig Key'
